name: triceps-pushdown-cable-incline
title: Triceps Pushdown: Cable (Incline)
primer: This exercise uses cables to isolate and work the triceps.
steps: Place an incline bench facing away from a cable pulley.
Attach a short straight bar to the pulley and adjust the height so that your arms can extend fully.
Lie face up on the bench and grasp the bar with a narrow overhand grip.
Keeping your upper arms still, slowly push the bar down towards your feet.
Pause at the bottom and then return to the starting position.
tips: Keep your elbows steady throughout this exercise.
